rounds.title: The Critics' Circle

questions.prompt: Which pick earned the HIGHEST average club rating?
choices: Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind
questions.note: 4.54★ from 14 members. The Matrix was next at 4.44★, then The Truman Show at 4.27★.
